notes: Quiver Launcher: not an emulator but an app (no system maps to it), downloaded from Apps like one and opened from Apps or Main menu > Quiver. It installs and starts game ports, recomps and decomps from GitHub and GitLab releases.

The official linux-arm64 AppImage (self-contained .NET 10, Avalonia, SDL3 for the pad), mounted; its apphost usr/bin/QuiverLauncher is run, never AppRun. Its native code has LSE atomics only behind run-time checks (outline-atomic helpers, .NET's own), so it runs on ARMv8.0.

Started from the read-only mount without $APPIMAGE, it keeps its library in ~/.local/share/QuiverLauncher (apps.json, settings.json, Apps/), outside ~/emulators: Delete keeps what it installed. Velopack updates only a mounted AppImage it was started as, and QuiverLauncher_SKIP_UPDATES=1 skips its check: retroforge-emu updates it like the emulators.
args: --run {rom}, Quiver's own way to start a library app by name (no card uses it yet). gui_args: its library window.
